subject: Pilot Scope & Commitments — Post-discovery summary and MAP
messages:
From: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@bridgestone.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com; marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@bridgestone.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Jan 2027 15:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Discovery call — Bridgestone inference use cases

Thanks for the deep dive today, Aditya. Couple quick clarifications so we have alignment before I loop in procurement:

- Pilot scope: confirm this is 2 models (intent classification + anonymized NLP extract) run against PRD-ish traffic (sample 10k/day).
- Data handling: all inference calls must not persist customer identifiers; KV cache lifetime needs to be configurable.
- Success metrics: 95th pctl latency < 200ms, cost target < $0.03/1k tokens equivalent, and accuracy no worse than current baseline for entity extraction.

I'll assemble a short internal note and introduce procurement. Priya will be the primary buyer for the pilot.

Jordan
Senior Product Manager — Customer AI
Bridgestone Mobility
From: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@bridgestone.com>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@bridgestone.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 8 Jan 2027 17:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call — Bridgestone inference use cases

Jordan — great notes, thanks. Replying with a concise post-call recap and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) attached. Short summary below and a few immediate asks so we can turn this into a scoped pilot:

Key pain we heard
- High latency in current on-prem classifier for peak times causing timeouts in customer workflows.
- Rising per-inference cost and brittle horizontal scaling for batch enrichment.

Pilot goals (proposed)
- Validate latency SLOs with Redwood hosted inference on a small production traffic slice (10k/day).
- Measure unit cost delta at existing traffic mix and confirm >20% cost improvement target via batching/quantization.
- Confirm data handling, KV cache config, and SOC 2 controls for PII avoidance.

Proposed MAP (attached: bridgestone-map-v1.xlsx) — key milestones
1) 2027-01-15: Sign pilot SOW (procurement + legal) — owner: Bridgestone (Priya) & Redwood (Marissa)
2) 2027-01-22: Pilot environment ready (data ingestion + model pinning) — owner: Redwood eng (Ben)
3) 2027-02-05: Start 14-day live evaluation window — owner: Bridgestone + Redwood
4) 2027-02-21: Evaluation review & decision (pilot success / extend / production rollout) — stakeholders: Jordan, Priya, Redwood PM/Eng

Immediate asks
- Priya: confirm procurement timeline and list any required PO terms by 2027-01-13.
- Jordan: confirm sample dataset drop window and redaction expectations.
- Bridgestone legal: we will share a redline-friendly SOW (SOW-draft-bridgestone.pdf) for review.

Attachments: bridgestone-map-v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW-draft-bridgestone.pdf (SOW template). I can hop on a quick contract sync if you'd like.

Thanks — happy to adjust dates.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

Date: Sat, 9 Jan 2027 08:41:00 -05:00

Forwarding the MAP and SOW template for legal/proc review. Small note on security: we have optional Private deployment if Bridgestone needs VPC + KMS-managed keys; default pilot will use isolated tenant in Redwood-hosted environment with token-level audit logs.

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Priya — will you confirm if procurement can sign the SOW by 2027-01-15? If helpful, I can propose a 30-minute contract review slot early next week (Mon/Tue).

Next steps I will take on behalf of Redwood:
- Share a trimmed SOW with bridgeable terms (SOW-draft-bridgestone.pdf) by EOD today.
- Provision a pilot tenant and test ingest instructions (Ben will be owner) by 2027-01-20.
- Prepare an instrumented evaluation plan with exact telemetry & pass/fail criteria for the 14-day window.

Jordan — noted the latency and cost targets. We'll include 95th-pctl latency and per-inference cost tracking in the evaluation dashboard.

If there are any stakeholders we missed, please add them to the thread. I'll send a calendar invite once we confirm the SOW date.

Cheers,
Aditya
